mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average 20-day return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.8% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.8%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.3 million units signals strong housing demand and elevated consumer confidence, which correlates with rising equity market sentiment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating economic momentum and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that delay rate cuts, increasing real interest rate risk and suppressing equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 310.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.5%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 per month combined with a declining unemployment rate signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth above 2.0% annualized, combined with stable inflation, signals a strong and sustainable economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL < 312.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
